race.comment: EVENING BRIDE (4) has the clearest recent form after being beaten just under a length by The Wirrulla Boy in a BM70 at this track, a sharp rebound from a plain soft-track run. She is proven at this track and distance, comes back to BM58 company and her fourth-up fitness gives her a strong platform. OFFA'S DYKE (1) is the danger after winning a Mdn at this venue by just under four lengths as a well-supported favourite, with Connor Murtagh staying aboard and solid track-and-trip figures to support the rise beyond maiden grade. SKATING ON BY (10) was beaten as favourite first-up, but she gets weight relief and has stronger prior form from a close CL2 third at this track. GRINZINGER GOLD (7) will be fitter for a couple of recent trials after bleeding at her last start. Has speed and is not to be discounted. ALLOUVRE (6) draws well today and another forward showing is on the cards.
